asset.title: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro
asset.author: Amazon Lumberyard
asset.modifications: DDS base mip decoded to PNG; BC5 Z reconstruction and DX-to-GL normal green inversion; explicit PBR/alpha recipe; duplicate-face vertex separation; authored normal-preserving glTF conversion

validated_scope: Finite XYZ positions and valid terminated source polygon vertex indices
Finite, complete ByPolygonVertex normal/UV arrays and valid corner attribute indices
Complete polygon material mappings within each connected Model's ordered material bindings
Existing object ids in every connection and normalized source texture relative references
source.identity_note: FBX has 1296 Geometry ids each bound to one Mesh Model. Parsed triangles total is 2832120; README unique count is an author catalog value, not an applied buffer-dedup result.

importer.change: Defer importer mesh.validate until duplicate faces have independent vertex indices; then run normal Blender validation

duplicate_preservation.policy: Separate duplicate face vertex indices; preserve positions, corner normals, both UV sets, material and winding; Blender validation must pass unchanged

normal_export.policy: Export normalized authored CORNER normals directly, bypassing Blender packed-normal precision loss

conversion.tangents: No authored tangent layer. Omit TANGENT in glTF; consumer generates MikkTSpace. A diagnostic export generated zero vectors, so robust cook generation remains a B2 requirement.
conversion.sampling: TextureUV, repeat S/T, linear magnification, trilinear minification
conversion.mip_scope: PNG contains base mip only; preserve DDS source/mip count; runtime/cook mip generation is separate
